name: Beth Baal Meon
overview: Beth Baal Meon, also known by variant names such as Baal-Meon, Beon, and Beth-Meon, is a city located in the territory assigned to the tribe of Reuben. Scripture records that this city was subdued by the Israelites as part of their conquest and settlement in the Promised Land, with its name appearing among the cities in the plains and border regions of Moab. The changing of city names, including Baalmeon, reflects the Israelites' establishment of their presence and authority in the region.
